name: One Acre Fund Rwanda (Tubura)
category: NGO / social enterprise - seedlings and farm inputs
location: Programme in 27 districts (Kigali City excluded) in 2021; new 1.4 ha tree nursery in Busanza, Kicukiro District, Kigali (opened 2026-07); network of over 2,000 community nurseries
offerings: Hass and Fuerte avocado seedlings (450,000 produced in 2022; 384,000 distributed Oct 2021, 316,500 of them subsidised and paid in instalments); agroforestry (e.g. Grevillea), fruit and indigenous tree seedlings; farm inputs
public_contact: Website www.oneacrefund.org (as printed in the 2025 press release). No order line or office address found; a media contact is printed in CRP-48 and is not an ordering channel
prices_published: none found (subsidised, instalment terms; no per-seedling price)
verified: Programme reported active in KT Press 2025-03-21 and 2026-07-01; not confirmed whether a non-member 2-10 ha farm can buy seedlings or at what price (2026-10-19)
notes: Also CRP-21 (largest avocado seedling supplier), CRP-24 (Busanza nursery), CRP-48 (community nurseries). Sale to non-members and delivery to the lake zones are unknown.

name: Rwanda Agriculture and Animal Resources Development Board (RAB)
category: Government research and extension - seedlings, nursery training, irrigation subsidy administration

name: Rwanda Forestry Authority (RFA) / National Tree Seed Centre
category: Government - forest tree seed, seedlings, grafted stock, cuttings
location: National Tree Seed Centre in Huye (Southern Province), Ruhande Arboretum; pick-up from a collection centre chosen online
offerings: Tree seeds, seedlings, grafted planting stocks and cuttings ordered via IremboGov (processing 5 days; pay online with a billing number)
public_contact: Not found: rfa.gov.rw could not be fetched from the research environment. Order route: IremboGov, Infrastructure and Environment, forest planting materials
prices_published: price depends on quantity of the seed type; no list found
certification: Centre 'collects and certifies seed' (IPS 2020); farmers had earlier complained about seed failure (almost 90%)
verified: Irembo service page read 2026-10-19; species list, prices and stock not shown
notes: Seed centre background: CRP-54 (2020). Eucalyptus and pines are RFA priority species (press); species available to private buyers unknown.

name: NAEB - PSAC project (Promoting Smallholder Agro-Export Competitiveness)
category: Government/IFAD programme - free grafted seedlings to beneficiary farmers (not a retail seller)
location: 13 districts; 2026A planting in Rwamagana, Bugesera, Nyanza, Huye, Rusizi, Karongi, Rutsiro
offerings: Free grafted avocado (150,000), mango (45,000) and macadamia (10,000) seedlings in the 2026A season; produced by PSAC-supported women and youth groups; avocado 800 ha / mango 200 ha / macadamia 100 ha plan
public_contact: info@naeb.gov.rw; Toll free 3800; MAGERWA Street / KK 6 AV, P.O. Box 104, Kigali (as printed on naeb.gov.rw)
verified: Programme described in NAEB newsletter Oct-Dec 2025 and NAEB news page; eligibility for a privately owned farm unknown (2026-10-19)
notes: Also CRP-13. Nursery names are not published. Treat as a possible subsidy route, not as a supplier with stock.
